title: Cow

steps.text: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders.
steps.cue: Hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.

steps.text: Let your belly drop gently toward the mat.
Lift your chest and tailbone and slide your shoulder blades down your back.
Look slightly up and hold for one slow breath, then return to a flat back.
steps.cue: Look slightly up. One slow breath.
steps.say: Look slightly up and hold for one slow breath.

mistakes: Cranking the neck too far back.
Collapsing the chest between the shoulders.
stopIf: Come out if your knees, wrists or lower back hurt.

anatomy.why: Letting the belly drop lengthens the front of the trunk while the back muscles gently arch the spine.
